The EBLC table supplied by the input is extracted and later used to find bitmap glyph data.
The fuzzer selects a fixed bitmap strike advertised by the crafted EBLC table.
Loading glyph zero with FT_LOAD_COLOR reaches the embedded bitmap loader.
The glyph bitmap height is read directly from the EBDT glyph metrics controlled by the input.
The allocation size is computed from input-derived bitmap dimensions and pitch before copying bitmap bits.
The source byte count is checked against the glyph record limit, not against the heap buffer allocation boundary.
Bitmap bytes are OR-written into the allocated glyph bitmap one byte at a time.
